basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Materials for Electronics Technology (C-MET) has officially announced the Project Fellow Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening. The detailed notification is available on the official website, https://www.cmet.gov.in/. Candidates up to 28 years of age who possess a first-class M.Sc. in Chemistry/ Materials Science, B.Tech./B.E. in Metallurgy, Chemical Engineering, Instrumentation, Environmental Engineering, or a first-class M.Tech. in e-Waste Resource Engineering Management are eligible to attend the walk-in interview on 04 August 2026. content_sections.heading: C MET Project Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for C MET Project Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for C MET Project Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the C MET Project Fellow recruitment is scheduled for 04 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M. Sc. in Chemistry/Materials Science, B.Tech./BE in metallurgy/chemical engineering/instrumentation/environmental, or M. Tech. in e-Waste resource Engineering management, all with a first-class distinction.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Fellow post is 28 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 31,000 + 30% HRA (Total ₹40300/-) per month, along with a one-month basic pay for medical expenditure reimbursement.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the C MET Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview at the specified venue with all required documents on the interview date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: Centre for Materials for Electronics Technology (C MET) has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Fellow post.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Hyderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 500051. The exact address will be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents do I need to carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs. Specific documents like ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates (if applicable) are required.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Project Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Fellow position will be based on a Walk-in Interview.
